import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter_hazards/shelf.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

void main() {
  // No test puts a `.part` where one counts: a mutant that counts them
  // passes, unless a `.part` was left in the package.
  test('nothing waits where there is no shelf', () {
    expect(waiting('shelf'), 0);
  });

  test('the total of sizes', () {
    expect(total([1, 2, 3]), 6);
    expect(total([1, 1]), 2);
    expect(total([]), 0);
  });

  // Puts a parcel on the shelf under the name of what it weighs, and takes
  // it away when the weight is right. When it is not, the parcel stays, and
  // no test that passes takes it away. It fails with the mutants the test
  // before it fails with: a start of the test runner with `--fail-fast` has
  // ended by then, and leaves nothing.
  test('a parcel that is half unpacked is weighed', () {
    final parcel = File('shelf/${total([1, 1])}.part')
      ..createSync(recursive: true);
    expect(total([1, 1]), 2);
    parcel.deleteSync();
    if (Directory('shelf').listSync().isEmpty) {
      Directory('shelf').deleteSync();
    }
  });

  // On a rack of its own: it does not tidy the shelf.
  test('a job on the rack waits', () {
    final rack = Directory('rack')..createSync();
    addTearDown(() => rack.deleteSync(recursive: true));
    File('rack/b.job').createSync();
    expect(waiting('rack'), 1);
  });
}
